verdict.rationale: Codex Plugins is a plugin platform, not an agent, so this axis applies. OpenAI documents that plugins use MCP to expose server-backed tools to ChatGPT and Codex (docs-33, docs-57), and that remote MCP-only plugins can be published (docs-40). The official 'Codex official' marketplace (docs-63, gh-11) ships plugins wired with MCP servers, which install MCP tools into agent sessions (docs-45, docs-15). However, this is MCP integration for Codex/ChatGPT through plugin packaging, not a first-party MCP endpoint that any external agent can connect to directly. Missing for 10: an official standalone MCP server/endpoint for connecting arbitrary agents, documentation of connecting non-OpenAI agents, independent or hands-on corroboration.
